name: 马丁努斯·贝杰林克
bio_short: 荷兰微生物学家和植物学家, 病毒学的共同奠基人. 他确立了"病毒" (Virus) 的概念, 将其描述为"流动的活体传染物" (`beijerinck_virus_concept_1898`). 此外, 他还发现了对农业至关重要的"生物固氮"现象.
bio_short_en: A Dutch microbiologist and botanist, and a co-founder of virology. He established the concept of the 'Virus', describing it as a 'living contagious fluid' (`beijerinck_virus_concept_1898`). Additionally, he discovered biological nitrogen fixation, which is crucial for agriculture.
